claims: No. 1 seed Texas defeated No. 2 seed Michigan 77-41 in the 2026 NCAA Women's Basketball Tournament Elite Eight.
Texas advanced to their second consecutive Final Four.
Madison Booker led Texas with 19 points.
The game venue was Dickies Arena in Fort Worth, Texas.
Madison Booker had 19 points and 7 rebounds for Texas.
Justice Carlton had 15 points for Texas.
Rori Harmon had 13 assists for Texas.
Texas will face UCLA in the Final Four.
Texas led 18-4 early in the game.
Texas maintained a 30-plus point lead for much of the game.
The game's margin was one of the largest in Elite Eight history
